name: Acceptance page plugin
description: The acceptance run's fixture for the Plugins page: installed from a folder through the page (main's picker, stubbed by the test build), its OK pressed, its tools shown in its detail, then removed on its sealed card. Its server answers a listing; nothing calls its tool. Its one status-bar line is drawn by its own layer, so installing it loads the window's document again.

PAGE_KEY.title: Page key
PAGE_KEY.description: A key the page plugin would send (the run only opens the key dialog for it).
